correctness.rationale: Reconstructing GP(12,5) yields exactly 35,219 augmented independent faces. The supplied exact checker finds 17,607 disjoint face pairs and a complete topological sort of all 205,680 oriented incidences, proving the discrete Morse matching acyclic. Exactly four critical 5-faces and one critical 6-face remain and signed gradient elimination gives the zero 4-by-1 integral Morse boundary. Thus reduced H5=Z^4 and H6=Z, no other reduced homology. The explicit Cayley graph isomorphism and five-round individualized color refinement show that the displayed 144 S4×S3 maps exhaust all automorphisms. Independent signed fixed-simplex evaluation on each of 15 class representatives matches a cycle-orbit polynomial evaluation for all 144 automorphisms. The Lefschetz table and actual-character nonnegativity uniquely force the claimed H6 sign and H5 four-point sign-twisted permutation character. Computation is complete and exact, not a finite experiment purporting to establish an infinite claim.

value.rationale: GP(12,5) is the Nauru/F24A graph, a canonical 24-vertex cubic highly symmetric graph with 144 automorphisms. Its published nonequivariant wedge does not disclose which of its many compatible rational group modules occur. The exact full-group determination has a natural interpretation: degree-six orientation is sign(S4), while degree-five homology is a sign(S4)sign(S3) twist of the natural four-point permutation representation. This resolves a complete, structurally motivated equivariant invariant, including the absence of full-group fixed classes and the contrasting right-factor action. No family theorem is necessary for the mathematical value of this natural exact finite classification.
